description:
Get a specific payment by ID from Holded.

Args:
  - payment_id (string): The payment ID to retrieve (required)
  - response_format ('json' | 'markdown'): Output format (default: 'json')

Returns:
  Payment details including document ID, amount, date, and account information.

response_format.description: Output format: 'json' for structured data or 'markdown' for human-readable

name: holded_invoicing_get_payment
title: Get Holded Payment
